title: Understanding Oxide Formation on CdTe via EELS Edge Fine Structure
content: CdTe is a solar cell material that has a near optimal band gap for capturing solar energy, giving it a high Shockley-Queisser efficiency limit, similar to that of Si [1]. However, in the present, CdTe device efficiency is significantly lower than that of Si solar devices, with a record of 23.1% for CdTe as opposed to 27.6% for Si [2]. This makes improving CdTe device efficiency important in the current development of CdTe solar devices.
